_doc: Per-product pick instructions for Prosol branches (lib/pick-notes.js). `codes` match the api_sku / prosol_sku the pipeline uses. `note` prints on that order in the branch email. `min_spare` = units a branch must hold beyond the order quantity before routing picks it first (default 1); routing still falls back to exact cover if no branch has the spare. `exclude_locations` = Prosol location ids routing never picks for this product (bad stock data there); omit `note` for a routing-only rule.
